query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TBP_EQUIP_EVENT ( MONTH ,RES_ID ,EVENT_TIME ,EVENT_ID ,PROC_MODE ,PERIOD ,OPER ,MAT_ID ,RECIPE_ID ,LOT_ID ,WAFER_ID ,FRAME_ID ,CMF_FIELD01 ) VALUES( TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:event_time,1,19),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'YYYYMM')) ,:res_id ,TO_TIMESTAMP(:event_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') ,:event_id ,:proc_mode ,:period ,:oper ,:mat_id ,:recipe_id ,:lot_id ,:wafer_id ,:frame_id ,:raw_mat_type )

INSERT INTO TBP_EQUIP_EVENT ( MONTH ,RES_ID ,EVENT_TIME ,EVENT_ID ,PROC_MODE ,PERIOD ,OPER ,MAT_ID ,RECIPE_ID ,LOT_ID ,WAFER_ID ,FRAME_ID ,CMF_FIELD01 ,CMF_FIELD02 ) VALUES( TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:event_time,1,19),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'YYYYMM')) ,:res_id ,TO_TIMESTAMP(:event_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') ,:event_id ,:proc_mode ,:period ,:oper ,:mat_id ,:recipe_id ,:lot_id ,:wafer_id ,:frame_id ,:raw_mat_type ,:abnormal_case )
UPDATE TBP_EQUIP_EVENT SET PERIOD = :period WHERE RES_ID = :res_id AND EVENT_TIME = TO_TIMESTAMP(:event_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND EVENT_ID = :last_event

INSERT INTO TBP_EQUIP_EVENT ( MONTH ,RES_ID ,EVENT_TIME ,EVENT_ID ,PROC_MODE ,PERIOD ,OPER ,MAT_ID ,RECIPE_ID ,LOT_ID ,WAFER_ID ,FRAME_ID ,CMF_FIELD01 ,CMF_FIELD03 ,CMF_FIELD04 ,CMF_FIELD05 ) VALUES( TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:event_time,1,19),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'YYYYMM')) ,:res_id ,TO_TIMESTAMP(:event_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') ,:event_id ,:proc_mode ,:period ,:oper ,:mat_id ,:recipe_id ,:lot_id ,:wafer_id ,:frame_id ,:raw_mat_type ,:pickup_count ,:frame_time ,:abr_case )
UPDATE TBP_EQUIP_EVENT SET CMF_FIELD02 = :abn_case WHERE RES_ID = :res_id AND EVENT_TIME = TO_TIMESTAMP(:event_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND EVENT_ID = :last_event

SELECT RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" ,TO_CHAR(EVENT_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "EVENT TIME" ,EVENT_ID AS "EVENT ID" ,PROC_MODE AS "MODE" ,PERIOD AS "TERM(Sec)" ,OPER AS "OPER ID" ,MAT_ID AS "PART ID" ,RECIPE_ID AS "RECIPE ID" ,LOT_ID AS "LOT ID" ,WAFER_ID AS "WAFER ID" ,FRAME_ID AS "FRAME ID" FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND RES_ID = :res_id AND MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY EVENT_TIME DESC,FRAME_ID DESC

SELECT RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" ,TO_CHAR(EVENT_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "EVENT TIME" ,EVENT_ID AS "EVENT ID" ,PROC_MODE AS "MODE" ,PERIOD AS "TERM(Sec)" ,OPER AS "OPER ID" ,MAT_ID AS "PART ID" ,RECIPE_ID AS "RECIPE ID" ,LOT_ID AS "LOT ID" ,WAFER_ID AS "WAFER ID" ,FRAME_ID AS "FRAME ID" FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND RES_ID = :res_id AND MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
UNION
SELECT RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" ,TO_CHAR(SET_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "EVENT TIME" ,'ALARM' AS "EVENT ID" ,'DOWN' AS "MODE" ,PERIOD AS "TERM(Sec)" ,OPER AS "OPER ID" ,'' AS "PART ID" ,RECIPE_ID AS "RECIPE ID" ,LOT_ID AS "LOT ID" ,'' AS "WAFER ID" ,'' AS "FRAME ID" FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND RES_ID = :res_id ORDER BY "EVENT TIME" DESC, "FRAME ID" DESC

SELECT EQEVENT.RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" , EQEVENT.PROC_MODE , SUM(EQEVENT.PERIOD) AS PERIOD FROM TBP_RESSTS RESSTS, TBP_EQUIP_EVENT EQEVENT WHERE EQEVENT.MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND RESSTS.RES_ID = EQEVENT.RES_ID AND RESSTS.RES_MAKER = :maker AND EQEVENT.EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') GROUP BY EQEVENT.RES_ID, EQEVENT.PROC_MODE ORDER BY EQEVENT.RES_ID

/* SELECT EQEVENT.RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" , EQEVENT.PROC_MODE , SUM(EQEVENT.PERIOD) AS PERIOD FROM TBP_RESSTS RESSTS, TBP_EQUIP_EVENT EQEVENT WHERE EQEVENT.MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND RESSTS.RES_ID = EQEVENT.RES_ID AND RESSTS.RES_MAKER = :maker AND RESSTS.RES_MODEL = :model AND EQEVENT.EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') GROUP BY EQEVENT.RES_ID, EQEVENT.PROC_MODE ORDER BY EQEVENT.RES_ID */ SELECT /*+ INDEX(TBP_EQUIP_EVENT IDX_TBP_EQUIP_EVENT_01) */ RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" , PROC_MODE , SUM(PERIOD) AS PERIOD FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE RES_ID IN (SELECT RES_ID FROM TBP_RESSTS WHERE RES_MAKER = :maker AND RES_MODEL = :model ) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month GROUP BY RES_ID, PROC_MODE ORDER BY RES_ID
/* SELECT RS.RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" , NVL(EE.PROC_MODE, (SELECT PROC_MODE FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND RES_ID = RS.RES_ID AND EVENT_TIME = ( SELECT MAX(EVENT_TIME) FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND RES_ID = RS.RES_ID ) AND ROWNUM = 1 )) AS "PROC_MODE" , SUM(EE.PERIOD) AS PERIOD FROM TBP_RESSTS RS LEFT OUTER JOIN TBP_EQUIP_EVENT EE ON EE.RES_ID = RS.RES_ID AND EE.MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND EE.EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE RS.RES_MAKER = :maker AND RS.RES_MODEL = :model GROUP BY RS.RES_ID, EE.PROC_MODE ORDER BY RS.RES_ID */

SELECT EQEVENT.RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" , EQEVENT.PROC_MODE , SUM(EQEVENT.PERIOD) AS PERIOD FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT EQEVENT, (SELECT RES_ID FROM TBP_RESSTS WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND RES_ID = :res_id AND RES_MAKER = :maker AND RES_MODEL = :model) RESSTS WHERE EQEVENT.MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND EQEVENT.RES_ID = :res_id --AND RESSTS.RES_MAKER = :maker --AND RESSTS.RES_MODEL = :model AND EQEVENT.EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND RESSTS.RES_ID = EQEVENT.RES_ID GROUP BY EQEVENT.RES_ID, EQEVENT.PROC_MODE ORDER BY EQEVENT.RES_ID
/* SELECT EQEVENT.RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" , EQEVENT.PROC_MODE , SUM(EQEVENT.PERIOD) AS PERIOD FROM TBP_RESSTS RESSTS, TBP_EQUIP_EVENT EQEVENT WHERE EQEVENT.MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND RESSTS.RES_ID = EQEVENT.RES_ID AND RESSTS.RES_MAKER = :maker AND RESSTS.RES_MODEL = :model AND EQEVENT.RES_ID = :res_id AND EQEVENT.EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') GROUP BY EQEVENT.RES_ID, EQEVENT.PROC_MODE ORDER BY EQEVENT.RES_ID */

SELECT RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" ,TO_CHAR(EVENT_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "EVENT TIME" ,EVENT_ID AS "EVENT ID" ,'' AS "UNIT ID" ,PROC_MODE AS "MODE" ,PERIOD AS "TERM(Sec)" ,OPER AS "OPER ID" ,MAT_ID AS "PART ID" ,RECIPE_ID AS "RECIPE ID" ,LOT_ID AS "LOT ID" FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND RES_ID = :res_id AND MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 1 AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 AND LOT_ID = DECODE(:lot_id, '', LOT_ID, :lot_id)
UNION
SELECT RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" ,TO_CHAR(SET_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "EVENT TIME" ,'ALARM' AS "EVENT ID" ,'' AS "UNIT ID" ,'DOWN' AS "MODE" ,PERIOD AS "TERM(Sec)" ,OPER AS "OPER ID" ,'' AS "PART ID" ,RECIPE_ID AS "RECIPE ID" ,LOT_ID AS "LOT ID" FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE AND MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND RES_ID = :res_id AND LOT_ID = DECODE(:lot_id, '', LOT_ID, :lot_id) AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 1 AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 1
UNION
SELECT RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" ,TO_CHAR(EVENT_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "EVENT TIME" ,EVENT_ID AS "EVENT ID" ,UNIT_ID AS "UNIT ID" ,PROC_MODE AS "MODE" ,PERIOD AS "TERM(Sec)" ,OPER AS "OPER ID" ,MAT_ID AS "PART ID" ,RECIPE_ID AS "RECIPE ID" ,LOT_ID AS "LOT ID" FROM TBP_UNIT_EVENT WHERE MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND RES_ID = :res_id AND LOT_ID = DECODE(:lot_id, '', LOT_ID, :lot_id) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 1 AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 ORDER BY "EVENT TIME" DESC

SELECT RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" ,TO_CHAR(EVENT_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "EVENT TIME" ,EVENT_ID AS "EVENT ID" ,'' AS "UNIT ID" ,PROC_MODE AS "MODE" ,PERIOD AS "TERM(Sec)" ,OPER AS "OPER ID" ,MAT_ID AS "PART ID" ,RECIPE_ID AS "RECIPE ID" ,LOT_ID AS "LOT ID" ,'' AS "WAFER ID" FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND RES_ID = :res_id AND LOT_ID = DECODE(:lot_id, '', LOT_ID, :lot_id) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 1 AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 UNION SELECT RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" ,TO_CHAR(EVENT_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "EVENT TIME" ,EVENT_ID AS "EVENT ID" ,UNIT_ID AS "UNIT ID" ,PROC_MODE AS "MODE" ,PERIOD AS "TERM(Sec)" ,OPER AS "OPER ID" ,MAT_ID AS "PART ID" ,RECIPE_ID AS "RECIPE ID" ,LOT_ID AS "LOT ID" ,'' AS "WAFER ID" FROM TBP_UNIT_EVENT WHERE MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND RES_ID = :res_id AND LOT_ID = DECODE(:lot_id, '', LOT_ID, :lot_id) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 1 AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 ORDER BY "EVENT TIME" DESC

SELECT EQEVENT.RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" , EQEVENT.PROC_MODE , SUM(EQEVENT.PERIOD) AS PERIOD FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT EQEVENT, ( SELECT RES_ID FROM TBP_RESSTS WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND RES_MODEL IN (??) AND RES_ID IN (?? ) AND RES_MAKER = :maker ) RESSTS WHERE 1=1 AND EQEVENT.MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND EQEVENT.EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND RESSTS.RES_ID = EQEVENT.RES_ID GROUP BY EQEVENT.RES_ID, EQEVENT.PROC_MODE ORDER BY EQEVENT.RES_ID

SELECT RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" ,TO_CHAR(EVENT_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "EVENT TIME" ,EVENT_ID AS "EVENT ID" ,'' AS "UNIT ID" ,PROC_MODE AS "MODE" ,PERIOD AS "TERM(Sec)" ,OPER AS "OPER ID" ,MAT_ID AS "PART ID" ,RECIPE_ID AS "RECIPE ID" ,LOT_ID AS "LOT ID" ,'' AS "WAFER ID" FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 1 AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 AND OPER = :oper AND RES_ID = :res_id AND LOT_ID = :lot_id UNION SELECT RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" ,TO_CHAR(EVENT_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "EVENT TIME" ,EVENT_ID AS "EVENT ID" ,UNIT_ID AS "UNIT ID" ,PROC_MODE AS "MODE" ,PERIOD AS "TERM(Sec)" ,OPER AS "OPER ID" ,MAT_ID AS "PART ID" ,RECIPE_ID AS "RECIPE ID" ,LOT_ID AS "LOT ID" ,'' AS "WAFER ID" FROM TBP_UNIT_EVENT WHERE MONTH BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 1 AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 AND OPER = :oper AND RES_ID = :res_id AND LOT_ID = :lot_id ORDER BY "EVENT TIME" DESC

WITH RT AS ( SELECT DECODE(EVENT_ID, 'EAPBSS_PROCESS_START', ROWNUM, 'EAPBSS_PROCESS_END', ROWNUM - 1) AS "NUM",MONTH,RES_ID, DECODE(EVENT_ID, 'EAPBSS_PROCESS_START', EVENT_TIME, 'EAPBSS_PROCESS_END', '') AS "EAPBSS_PROCESS_START", DECODE(EVENT_ID, 'EAPBSS_PROCESS_START', '', 'EAPBSS_PROCESS_END', EVENT_TIME) AS "EAPBSS_PROCESS_END", PROC_MODE,PERIOD,OPER,MAT_ID,RECIPE_ID,LOT_ID,WAFER_ID,FRAME_ID,CMF_FIELD01,CMF_FIELD02,CMF_FIELD03,CMF_FIELD04,CMF_FIELD05 FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH BETWEEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:sTime, 1, 6)) AND TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:eTime, 1, 6)) AND RES_ID = :res_id AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sTime, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:eTime, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID IN ('EAPBSS_PROCESS_START', 'EAPBSS_PROCESS_END') ORDER BY EVENT_TIME ) SELECT A.NUM,A.MONTH,A.RES_ID,B.EAPBSS_PROCESS_START,B.EAPBSS_PROCESS_END,A.OPER,A.MAT_ID,A.RECIPE_ID,MAX(A.LOT_ID) AS LOT_ID FROM RT A, (SELECT NUM, MAX(EAPBSS_PROCESS_START) AS EAPBSS_PROCESS_START, MAX(EAPBSS_PROCESS_END) AS EAPBSS_PROCESS_END, MAX(MAT_ID) AS MAT_ID, MAX(LOT_ID) AS LOT_ID FROM RT GROUP BY NUM) B WHERE 1=1 AND A.NUM = B.NUM AND NVL(A.MAT_ID, ' ') = NVL(B.MAT_ID, ' ') GROUP BY A.NUM,A.MONTH,A.RES_ID,B.EAPBSS_PROCESS_START,B.EAPBSS_PROCESS_END,A.OPER,A.MAT_ID,A.RECIPE_ID ORDER BY A.NUM

WITH RT AS ( SELECT * FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND RES_ID = :res_id AND MONTH BETWEEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:sTime, 1, 6)) AND TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:eTime, 1, 6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sTime, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:eTime, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID IN ('EAPSSS_PROCESS_START', 'EAPSSS_PROCESS_END') --ORDER BY EVENT_TIME )
SELECT DISTINCT A.MONTH,A.RES_ID,A.LOT_ID, TO_CHAR(B.PROCESS_START, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "PROCESS_START", TO_CHAR(B.PROCESS_END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "PROCESS_END", A.OPER,A.MAT_ID,A.RECIPE_ID FROM (SELECT MONTH,RES_ID,LOT_ID,MIN(EVENT_TIME) AS "PROCESS_START",MAX(EVENT_TIME) AS "PROCESS_END", MIN(EVENT_ID) AS "EVENT_ID" FROM RT GROUP BY MONTH,RES_ID,LOT_ID) B, RT A WHERE 1=1 AND A.MONTH = B.MONTH AND A.RES_ID = B.RES_ID AND A.EVENT_ID = B.EVENT_ID AND NVL(A.LOT_ID, ' ') = NVL(B.LOT_ID, ' ') ORDER BY "PROCESS_START"

WITH RT AS ( SELECT * FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH BETWEEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:sTime, 1, 6)) AND TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:eTime, 1, 6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sTime, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:eTime, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID IN ('EAPSSS_PROCESS_START', 'EAPSSS_PROCESS_END') AND LOT_ID LIKE :lot_id --ORDER BY EVENT_TIME )
SELECT DISTINCT A.MONTH,A.RES_ID,A.LOT_ID, TO_CHAR(B.PROCESS_START, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "PROCESS_START", TO_CHAR(B.PROCESS_END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "PROCESS_END", A.OPER,A.MAT_ID,A.RECIPE_ID FROM (SELECT MONTH,RES_ID,LOT_ID,MIN(EVENT_TIME) AS "PROCESS_START",MAX(EVENT_TIME) AS "PROCESS_END", MIN(EVENT_ID) AS "EVENT_ID" FROM RT GROUP BY MONTH,RES_ID,LOT_ID) B, RT A WHERE 1=1 AND A.MONTH = B.MONTH AND A.RES_ID = B.RES_ID AND A.EVENT_ID = B.EVENT_ID AND NVL(A.LOT_ID, ' ') = NVL(B.LOT_ID, ' ') ORDER BY "PROCESS_START"

SELECT * FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (:month, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM')) AND RES_ID= :res_id AND EVENT_TIME > TO_DATE(:event_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID = :event_id ORDER BY EVENT_TIME

UPDATE TBP_EQUIP_EVENT SET PERIOD = :period ,CMF_FIELD02 = :abn_case ,CMF_FIELD03 = :pickup_count ,CMF_FIELD04 = :frame_time WHERE RES_ID = :res_id AND EVENT_TIME = TO_TIMESTAMP(:event_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AND EVENT_ID = :last_event

SELECT NVL(SUM(FRAME_TIME),0) AS FRAME_TIME FROM ( SELECT /*+ INDEX_DESC(EVT UK_TBP_EQUIP_EVENT)*/ ROUND( EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (SYSTIMESTAMP - EVENT_TIME)) * 60 * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (SYSTIMESTAMP - EVENT_TIME))* 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM (SYSTIMESTAMP - EVENT_TIME)) ,2) AS FRAME_TIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT EVT WHERE 1=1 AND RES_ID = :res_id AND EVENT_ID = :event_id AND MONTH IN (TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1),'YYYYMM'),TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM')) AND ROWNUM = 1 )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND RES_ID = :res_id AND (PROC_MODE IN ('IDLE','ALARM') OR EVENT_ID = 'EAPDA_WAFER_END') /* IDLE, ALARM 또는 D/A 공정의 INDEX 제외 */ AND MONTH IN (TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1),'YYYYMM'),TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM')) AND PERIOD >= 1 /* W/B 공정에서 NSOP Recovery 기능 사용시 1초 이내에 idle, run 이 반복하여 발생함, 0초인 IDLE 은 제외하자 */ AND EVENT_TIME > ( SELECT /*+ INDEX_DESC(EVT UK_TBP_EQUIP_EVENT)*/ EVENT_TIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT EVT WHERE 1=1 AND RES_ID = :res_id AND EVENT_ID = :event_id AND MONTH IN (TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1),'YYYYMM'),TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM')) AND ROWNUM = 1 )

WITH VT AS ( SELECT FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(A.EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'M') AS WORK_MONTH , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(A.EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'W') AS WORK_WEEK , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(A.EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'D') AS WORK_DAY , A.RES_ID , TO_NUMBER(A.CMF_FIELD04) AS PERIOD , TO_NUMBER(A.CMF_FIELD03) AS PICKUP_CNT FROM ( SELECT * FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID = :event_id AND RES_ID = :res_id AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) != 0 AND CMF_FIELD05 = 'Y' ) A, ( SELECT MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04)) AS PERIOD FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID = :event_id AND RES_ID = :res_id AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) != 0 AND CMF_FIELD05 = 'Y' )C, ( SELECT MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03)) AS PICKUP_CNT FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID = :event_id AND RES_ID = :res_id AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) != 0 AND CMF_FIELD05 = 'Y' )D WHERE 1=1 AND TO_NUMBER(A.CMF_FIELD03) > D.PICKUP_CNT*0.8 AND TO_NUMBER(A.CMF_FIELD03) < D.PICKUP_CNT*1.2 AND TO_NUMBER(A.CMF_FIELD04)> C.PERIOD*0.8 AND TO_NUMBER(A.CMF_FIELD04) < C.PERIOD*1.2 ) SELECT WORK_MONTH,WORK_WEEK,WORK_DAY,RES_ID ,MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT) AS REP_PICKUP_CNT ,MEDIAN(PERIOD) AS REP_PERIOD , ROUND(MEDIAN(PERIOD)/MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT),2) AS ST , ROUND(3600/(MEDIAN(PERIOD)/MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT)),2) AS UPH FROM VT WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY WORK_MONTH,WORK_WEEK,WORK_DAY,RES_ID

SELECT MONTH,RES_ID,EVENT_TIME,EVENT_ID,PROC_MODE,PERIOD,OPER,MAT_ID,RECIPE_ID,LOT_ID,WAFER_ID,FRAME_ID,CMF_FIELD03 AS PROC_QTY, CMF_FIELD04 AS CYCLE_TIME, CMF_FIELD05 AS RUN_ONLY FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH in (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND RES_ID= :res_id AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID = :event_id ORDER BY EVENT_TIME

WITH VT AS ( SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT * FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID = :event_id AND RES_ID = :res_id AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) != 0 AND LOT_ID IS NOT NULL ) A, ( SELECT MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03)) AS M_PICKUP_COUNT , MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04)) AS M_CYCLE_TIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID = :event_id AND RES_ID = :res_id AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) != 0 AND LOT_ID IS NOT NULL ) B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03) < B.M_PICKUP_COUNT * 1.2 AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03) > B.M_PICKUP_COUNT * 0.8 AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) < B.M_CYCLE_TIME * 1.2 AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) > B.M_CYCLE_TIME * 0.8 ) SELECT NVL(ROUND(MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04))/MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03)),2),0) AS UPEH_ST , NVL(ROUND(3600/(MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04))/MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03))),2),0) AS UPEH FROM VT WHERE 1=1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NVL(SUM(PERIOD),0) AS RUN_TIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND RES_ID = :res_id AND PROC_MODE = 'RUN' ) A , ( SELECT NVL(SUM(PERIOD),0) AS INDEX_TIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND RES_ID = :res_id AND PROC_MODE = 'INDEX' ) B , ( SELECT NVL(SUM(PERIOD),0) AS ALARM_TIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND RES_ID = :res_id AND PROC_MODE = 'ALARM' ) C ,
( SELECT NVL(SUM(PERIOD),0) AS IDLE_TIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND RES_ID = :res_id AND PROC_MODE = 'IDLE' ) D , ( SELECT NVL(SUM(PERIOD),0) AS DISCONNECT_TIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND RES_ID = :res_id AND PROC_MODE = 'DISCONNECT' ) E , ( SELECT NVL(SUM(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03)),0) AS PROC_QTY FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND RES_ID = :res_id AND EVENT_ID = :event_id ) F

WITH VT AS ( SELECT A.RECIPE_ID , A.EVENT_TIME , A.RES_ID , TO_NUMBER(A.CMF_FIELD04) AS PERIOD , TO_NUMBER(A.CMF_FIELD03) AS PICKUP_CNT , CMF_FIELD05 AS RUN_ONLY , D.REP_PERIOD , D.REP_PICKUP_COUNT , E.M_PICKUP_COUNT , E.M_CYCLE_TIME , T.RUN_TIME , T.INDEX_TIME , T.ALARM_TIME , T.IDLE_TIME , T.DISCONNECT_TIME , T_PROC.PROC_QTY FROM ( SELECT * FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID = :event_id AND RES_ID = :res_id AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) != 0 AND LOT_ID IS NOT NULL ) A, ( SELECT MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04)) AS REP_PERIOD ,MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03)) AS REP_PICKUP_COUNT FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVENT_ID = :event_id AND RES_ID = :res_id AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) != 0 AND LOT_ID IS NOT NULL AND CMF_FIELD05 = 'Y'
)D, ( SELECT MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03)) AS M_PICKUP_COUNT , MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04)) AS M_CYCLE_TIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) != 0 AND LOT_ID IS NOT NULL ) E, ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(RUN_TIME)) AS RUN_TIME, ROUND(SUM(INDEX_TIME)) AS INDEX_TIME, ROUND(SUM(IDLE_TIME)) AS IDLE_TIME, ROUND(SUM(ALARM_TIME)) AS ALARM_TIME, ROUND(SUM(DISCONNECT_TIME)) AS DISCONNECT_TIME FROM ( SELECT DECODE(PROC_MODE,'RUN',SUM(MATH_PERIOD),0) AS RUN_TIME ,DECODE(PROC_MODE,'INDEX',SUM(MATH_PERIOD),0) AS INDEX_TIME ,DECODE(PROC_MODE,'IDLE',SUM(MATH_PERIOD),0) AS IDLE_TIME ,DECODE(PROC_MODE,'ALARM',SUM(MATH_PERIOD),0) AS ALARM_TIME ,DECODE(PROC_MODE,'DISCONNECT',SUM(MATH_PERIOD),0) AS DISCONNECT_TIME FROM ( SELECT EVENT_TIME,PROC_MODE,B.MAX_EVENT, B.MIN_EVENT,PERIOD ,DECODE(EVENT_TIME, B.MAX_EVENT , ((TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - B.MAX_EVENT) * 24*60*60) , B.MIN_EVENT, ((B.MIN_EVENT - TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) * 24*60*60) , PERIOD) AS MATH_PERIOD FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT A, ( SELECT MAX(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE)) MAX_EVENT, MIN(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE)) MIN_EVENT FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND RES_ID = :res_id ) B WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND RES_ID = :res_id GROUP BY EVENT_TIME,PROC_MODE, B.MAX_EVENT, B.MIN_EVENT,PERIOD ORDER BY EVENT_TIME DESC ) GROUP BY PROC_MODE ) ) T, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03)),0) AS PROC_QTY FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6), SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND RES_ID = :res_id AND EVENT_ID = :event_id ) T_PROC ) SELECT MAX(A.RECIPE_ID) AS FN_GET_MATH_ST(:res_oper -- RES_OPER , MEDIAN(A.UPEH_ST) , :comp_qty -- COMP QTY , :oper) -- OPER AS UPEH_ST , FN_GET_MATH_UPH_V02(:res_oper -- RES_OPER , :res_model -- RES_MODEL , MEDIAN(A.UPEH) -- UPH , :net_die -- NET DIE , :comp_qty -- COMP_QTY , :oper ,'N') AS UPEH , FN_GET_MATH_UPH_V02(:res_oper -- RES_OPER , :res_model -- RES_MODEL , MEDIAN(A.UPEH) -- UPEH , :net_die -- NET DIE , :comp_qty -- COMP_QTY , :oper ,'Y') -- OPER AS UPEH_WAFER_CHANGE/**/ , FN_GET_MATH_UPH_V02(:res_oper -- RES_OPER , :res_model -- RES_MODEL , MEDIAN(B.UPH) -- UPH , :net_die -- NET DIE , :comp_qty -- COMP_QTY , :oper ,'N') -- OPER AS UPH/**/ , FN_GET_MATH_UPH_V02(:res_oper -- RES_OPER , :res_model -- RES_MODEL , MEDIAN(B.UPH) -- UPH , :net_die -- NET DIE , :comp_qty -- COMP_QTY , :oper ,'Y') -- OPER AS UPH_WAFER_CHANGE/**/ , FN_GET_MATH_ST(:res_oper -- RES_OPER , MEDIAN(B.UPH_ST) , :comp_qty -- COMP QTY , :oper) -- OPER AS UPH_ST , SUM(RUN_TIME) AS RUN_TIME, SUM(INDEX_TIME) AS INDEX_TIME , SUM(ALARM_TIME) AS ALARM_TIME, SUM(IDLE_TIME) AS IDLE_TIME, SUM(DISCONNECT_TIME) AS DISCONNECT_TIME, SUM(PROC_QTY) AS PICKUP_QTY , B.FRAME_COUNT , FN_GET_MATH_PROC_QTY( :res_oper -- RES_OPER , :res_model -- RES_MODEL , SUM(PROC_QTY) -- PROCESS QTY , :comp_qty -- COMP_QTY , :oper -- OPER ) AS PROC_QTY , COUNT(A.RECIPE_ID) AS RECIPE_COUNT FROM ( SELECT RECIPE_ID, FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'M') AS WORK_MONTH , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'W') AS WORK_WEEK , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'D') AS WORK_DAY , REP_PICKUP_COUNT, REP_PERIOD , VT.RUN_TIME, VT.INDEX_TIME, VT.ALARM_TIME, VT.IDLE_TIME, VT.DISCONNECT_TIME, VT.PROC_QTY , NVL(ROUND(MEDIAN(PERIOD)/MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT),2),0) AS UPEH_ST , NVL(ROUND(3600/(MEDIAN(PERIOD)/MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT)),2),0) AS UPEH , COUNT(*) AS FRAME_COUNT FROM VT WHERE 1=1 AND PICKUP_CNT < M_PICKUP_COUNT * 1.2 AND PICKUP_CNT > M_PICKUP_COUNT * 0.8 AND PERIOD < M_CYCLE_TIME * 1.2 AND PERIOD > M_CYCLE_TIME * 0.8 GROUP BY RECIPE_ID , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'M') , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'W') , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'D') , REP_PICKUP_COUNT,REP_PERIOD, VT.RUN_TIME, VT.INDEX_TIME, VT.ALARM_TIME, VT.IDLE_TIME, VT.DISCONNECT_TIME, VT.PROC_QTY ) A, ( SELECT FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'M') AS WORK_MONTH , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'W') AS WORK_WEEK , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'D') AS WORK_DAY , NVL(ROUND(MEDIAN(PERIOD)/MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT),2),0) AS UPH_ST , NVL(ROUND(3600/(MEDIAN(PERIOD)/MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT)),2),0) AS UPH , COUNT(*) AS FRAME_COUNT FROM VT WHERE 1=1 AND RUN_ONLY = 'Y' AND PICKUP_CNT < REP_PICKUP_COUNT * 1.2 AND PICKUP_CNT > REP_PICKUP_COUNT * 0.8 AND PERIOD < REP_PERIOD * 1.2 AND PERIOD > REP_PERIOD * 0.8 GROUP BY FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'M') , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'W') , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(TO_CHAR(CAST(EVENT_TIME AS DATE),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'D') ) B WHERE 1=1 AND A.WORK_DAY=B.WORK_DAY GROUP BY A.WORK_MONTH,A.WORK_WEEK,A.WORK_DAY,B.FRAME_COUNT

,TO_NUMBER(A.CMF_FIELD04) AS PERIOD ,CMF_FIELD05,RN,REP_PERIOD,REP_PICKUP_COUNT ,B.MES_UPH FROM ( SELECT EVT.*,ROWNUM AS RN FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT EVT, MRASRESDEF@FATOMES RES WHERE 1=1 AND RES.RES_ID = EVT.EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVT.EVENT_ID = :event_id AND EVT.CMF_FIELD05 = 'Y' AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) != 0 AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03) != 0 AND EVT.LOT_ID IS NOT NULL ) A, ( SELECT MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04)) AS REP_PERIOD ,MEDIAN(TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03)) AS REP_PICKUP_COUNT FROM TBP_EQUIP_EVENT EVT, MRASRESDEF@FATOMES RES WHERE 1=1 AND RES.RES_ID = EVT.RES_ID AND RES.FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND RES.RES_GRP_6 = :res_model AND EVT.OPER = :oper AND EVT.MAT_ID = :mat_id AND EVT.MONTH IN (SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,6),SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,6)) AND EVT.EVENT_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(:end_tran_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND EVT.EVENT_ID = :event_id AND EVT.CMF_FIELD05 = 'Y' AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD04) != 0 AND TO_NUMBER(CMF_FIELD03) != 0 AND EVT.LOT_ID IS NOT NULL ) M, ( SELECT UPEH AS MES_UPH FROM CRASUPHDEF@FATOMES WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND RES_MODEL = :res_model AND OPER = :oper AND MAT_ID = :mat_id ) B ) SELECT FN_GET_WORK_DATE(:end_tran_time,'M') AS WORK_MONTH , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(:end_tran_time,'W') AS WORK_WEEK , FN_GET_WORK_DATE(:end_tran_time,'D') AS WORK_DAY , :res_oper AS RES_OPER , :res_model AS RES_MODEL , :mat_id AS MAT_ID , :oper AS OPER , RECIPE_ID , MAT.MAT_CMF_13 AS NET_DIE_COUNT /**/ , NVL(GCM.DATA_1,0) AS COMP_QTY /**/ , SUBSTR(:start_tran_time,0,8) AS SEARCH_START_DAY , SUBSTR(:end_tran_time,0,8) AS SEARCH_END_DAY , MAX(RN) AS FRAME_COUNT ,MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT) AS REP_PICKUP_COUNT ,MEDIAN(PERIOD) AS REP_CYCLE_TIME , MES_UPH -- , NVL(ROUND(3600/(MEDIAN(PERIOD)/MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT)),2),0) AS UPH , FN_GET_MATH_UPH(:res_oper -- RES_OPER , :res_model -- RES_MODEL ,NVL(ROUND(3600/(MEDIAN(PERIOD)/MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT)),2),0) -- UPH ,MAT.MAT_CMF_13 -- NET DIE , NVL(GCM.DATA_1,0) -- AUTO LOSS QTY ,:oper) -- OPER AS UPH/**/ , FN_GET_MATH_ST(:res_oper -- RES_OPER ,NVL(ROUND(MEDIAN(PERIOD)/MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT),2),0) , NVL(GCM.DATA_1,0) -- COMP QTY ,:oper) -- OPER AS UPH_ST -- , ROUND((NVL(ROUND(3600/(MEDIAN(PERIOD)/MEDIAN(PICKUP_CNT)),2),0) / MES_UPH) * 100,2) AS IN_TIME FROM CWIPRESLTH@FATOMES WHERE TRAN_CODE = 'START' AND HIST_DEL_FLAG = ' ' ) PREV , ( SELECT FACTORY, END_RES_ID AS RES_ID, MAT_ID, LOT_ID, HIST_SEQ, OLD_OPER AS OPER, QTY_1 AS OUT_QTY, LOSS_QTY_1, TRAN_TIME AS OUT_TIME, TO_NUMBER(START_HIST_SEQ) AS START_SEQ FROM CWIPLOTEND@FATOMES LOT WHERE FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND OWNER_CODE='PROD' AND MAT_VER=1 AND LOT_TYPE='W' AND END_RES_ID <> ' ' ) POST , MESMGR.MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES OPERDEF WHERE 1=1 AND PREV.FACTORY = POST.FACTORY AND PREV.RES_ID = POST.RES_ID AND PREV.MAT_ID = POST.MAT_ID AND PREV.LOT_ID = POST.LOT_ID AND PREV.HIST_SEQ = POST.START_SEQ AND PREV.IN_TIME <> POST.OUT_TIME AND PREV.OPER = OPERDEF.OPER AND PREV.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND OPERDEF.OPER_GRP_4 = :oper_group ) SELECT LOT.OPERGROUP , LOT.OPER , MAT.MAT_CMF_10 AS PIN_TYPE , EV.MAT_ID , EV.RECIPE_ID , RES.RES_GRP_6 MODEL , EV.LOT_ID , ROUND(SUM ( CASE WHEN PROC_MODE IN ('RUN', 'INDEX') THEN PERIOD ELSE 0 END ) / NULLIF(SUM ( CASE WHEN EV.EVENT_ID = :event_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),0) AS REP_CYCLE_TIME , ROUND(MEDIAN (TO_NUMBER(EV.CMF_FIELD03)),0) AS PICKUP_COUNT , ROUND(3600 / (SUM ( CASE WHEN PROC_MODE IN ('RUN', 'INDEX') THEN PERIOD ELSE 0 END ) / NULLIF(SUM (EV.CMF_FIELD03),0)),0) AS FA_UPH , ROUND(SUM ( CASE WHEN PROC_MODE IN ('RUN', 'INDEX') THEN PERIOD ELSE 0 END ) / NULLIF(SUM (EV.CMF_FIELD03),0),2) AS FA_ST , SUM ( CASE WHEN EV.EVENT_ID = TO_TIMESTAMP(LOT.OUT_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') GROUP BY LOT.OPERGROUP, LOT.OPER, MAT.MAT_CMF_10, EV.MAT_ID, EV.RECIPE_ID, RES.RES_GRP_6, EV.LOT_ID
